{{Quote|Their world is sprinkled with thousands of rock pillars. Most of the best food plants grow on the tops. Unfortunately, so does a nasty predator avian. It makes for&mdash;well, for pretty much just what he said.|Dubrak Quennto|<ref name="of">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
This '''avian species''' was native to the [[Pashvi/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pashvi (species)|Pashvi]]. The [[Bird/Legends|avians]] were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]], and ate Pashvi. They lived atop the thousands of stone pillars that dotted the world's surface.<ref name="CSWE III 14">{{CSWECite|III|14}}</ref>
